capacity_proof.fact: Advances the same input pointer by 812 before copying the following 16-byte route header.
Uses global+12 as record base and 80-byte stride.

field_evidence.fact: Initializer clears twenty halfword indices and initializes both timers to 45.
Initializer selects first/last/third records from flag bits 4/1/2, with zero defaults.
Consumer uses all three direction components and converts the integer range to float for squared XZ distance comparison.
Mixer accesses indices at prefix-base+46 and length at prefix-base+88, equivalent to record+34 and record+76.

limits: Capacity is proven by the serialized payload boundary. No runtime clamp for count <= 10 was found.
The meanings of the two copied bytes at header+10 and record+74 are unestablished.
Range is an integer threshold compared against squared XZ distance; an unsquared geometric radius interpretation is not proven.
